_doc: Orthographic camera matched to ref/courtyard.webp. The castle itself is in plan.json.

camera._doc: Orthographic. elevation = downward tilt from horizontal (barrel lid ellipse ratio ~0.6 -> ~38 deg). yaw = turn from north toward east, set so east-west lines rise ~0.12 px/px to the right like the gatehouse. px_per_m = 52 frames the whole castle, wall tops and the ground outside the walls, like the reference composition. The reference draws props at about 70 px/m and the gate oversized.
